metric: macro mean classifier score gap: true_high minus false_high, per selected video

condition_notes.original_similarity_adj_only: Original temporal output; actual similarity adjacency; self-only distance adjacency. Both graph branches and their learned transforms remain present.
condition_notes.original_distance_adj_only: Original temporal output; self-only similarity adjacency; actual distance adjacency. Both graph branches and their learned transforms remain present.
condition_notes.original_self_only_adjacency: Original temporal output; both graph adjacencies are identity. Graph-layer convolution residuals remain active.
condition_notes.shuffle_full_recomputed_graph: Shuffled input; similarity adjacency recomputed; distance adjacency remains positional as in normal forward.
condition_notes.shuffle_original_graph_links: Shuffled input; both original adjacency matrices are permuted to preserve links between the same snippet identities.
condition_notes.shuffle_self_only_adjacency: Shuffled input; both graph adjacencies are identity. Graph-layer convolution residuals remain active.
